upg5:1.1: Taṇhaṅkara, the great hero, Medhaṅkara, of great repute,
upg5:1.2: Saraṇaṅkara, who benefits the world, Dīpaṅkara, the bright one,
upg5:2.1: Koṇḍañña, head of the people, Maṅgala, a bull of a man,
upg5:2.2: The wise one Sumana, whose mind is well, Revata, who increases delight,
upg5:3.1: Sobhita, endowed with good qualities, Anomadassī, supreme man,
upg5:3.2: Paduma, the lamp of the world, Nārada, the best of guides,
upg5:4.1: Padumuttara, an excellent being, Sumedha, the greatest person,
upg5:4.2: Sujāta, greatest in all the world, Piyadassī, a bull of a man,
upg5:5.1: Atthadassī, the compassionate one, Dhammadassī, darkness-dispeller,
upg5:5.2: Siddhattha, unequalled in the world, Tissa, who was most restrained,
upg5:6.1: Phussa, excellent Sambuddha, Vipassī, who has no likeness,
upg5:6.2: Sikhī, the Teacher who is a benefit to all, Vessabhū, who gives happiness,
upg5:7.1: Kakusandha, the leader of the pack, Koṇāgamana, who gave up what is harmful,
upg5:7.2: Kassapa, the glorious one, and Gotama, the Sakyan bull.
upg5:8.1: Through their truth and virtue, and the strength of their patience and friendliness,
upg5:8.2: may these (Buddhas) always protect you with good health and happiness!
